dataset_citation.title: WiFi CSI dataset for device-to-device localization

mean_error.definition: mean 2-D Euclidean distance between estimated and true positions, as reported (papers use the dataset's own coordinates)

floor_accuracy.definition: percentage of test samples whose floor is estimated correctly (floor hit rate)

building_accuracy.definition: percentage of test samples whose building is estimated correctly

notes: No 0.2 loader. The 0.1 table held only numbers computed by IndoorLoc 0.1 on synthetic demo data.
